title: docs(skills): the objectstack-ui router names action refusals
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1XdbbGasMNVx41tq3hZKV4)_

Fixes #35178

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-ui` 技能入口路由表的 Actions 行加上「refusing by code (`refusals`)」,与 `rules/actions.md` 该节标题同词;同文件 First checks 第 3 条删去一处复述(": it decides what to write"),token 棘轮该行 2277 → 2279。
- 为什么改:规则文件已教授动作的 `refusals` 声明(按码拒绝并返回翻译后的消息),但路由表没提,找「动作被拒时的提示」的模型不会被导向该规则。
- 风险与回滚:只动发布技能的一行路由文字、一处删句、棘轮一行与 changeset;无运行时影响。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 路由表 Actions 行与 First checks 第 3 条(被删的从句是否确属复述);② `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 的 objectstack-ui SKILL.md 行注释与 +2 上调。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md is 2279 tokens (ceiling 2279; headroom 0)` 且末行 ✓。
- 需要你做的:审阅并合并(`skills/**` 属 Tier H 受管面)。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, routing table: the Actions row ("A button or operation: `locations`, visibility, dialog and toast copy, params, new tab, the body's `ctx`") gains ", refusing by code (`refusals`)" — the words of `rules/actions.md`'s heading "Refusing by code (`refusals`)" — so a model looking for a refused action's message is routed to that rule (+31 bytes).
- Same file, paid down first: First checks 3 drops ": it decides what to write" (-26 bytes), which restates First checks 1's "where they differ, the installed contract is right". The paragraph is reflowed over the same four lines (a re-wrap moves no bytes and pays nothing).
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` row moves by the measured remainder, 2277 -> 2279, pinned AT the measurement (zero headroom), with its row note.
- `.changeset/35178-ui-router-names-refusals.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, carrying both declaration lines.

Raise authority, quoted verbatim and untranslated — the standing ruling of 2026-10-27 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, made the gate-recognised path by ruling record 6513306068 (letter B): restatement in the same file is cut first, the remainder moves by measurement.

Ratchet row: 9128 bytes (9108 priced) / 2277 tokens -> 9133 bytes (9113 priced) / 2279 tokens; measured remainder +2, `ceil((9133 - 20) / 4) == 2279`.

Skill size readings (tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, base `f4dbcc21` -> head `8254c29b`):

| Reading | Before | After |
|:--|--:|--:|

| All published `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines (sum) | 4830 | 4830 |
| All published `skills/*/SKILL.md` bytes (sum) | 253765 | 253770 |

## Tests

Text-only change to served skill text and one ratchet row; no tested behaviour changed, so no ablation.

```
✓ check-skills-token-ratchet self-test: 104 cases pass.
```

Before re-pinning the row, the same gate read `2279 / 2277 (+2)` and exited 1 — the remainder this PR carries.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `Most traps below pass it.` (First checks 4) sits next to the Traps heading "each parses, then fails at run time"; not cut, because passing `os validate` is a wider claim than parsing.
- The frontmatter description lists `*.action.ts` while the routing table's In column says `src/actions/*.actions.ts`; `examples/` uses both spellings (2 vs 1). Noted only.
